overview_heading: Start from clear boundaries, ship reliable software continuously.
overview_copy: One entry point for Go and React, with stable boundaries reserved for contracts, data and automation pipelines.
landing_hero_title_line1: From a single source of truth to
landing_hero_subtitle: A production-grade full-stack starter for modern web platforms and SaaS products. TypeSpec is the single contract source, compiling into OpenAPI, a typed Go server and a typed React Query client — the frontend build embeds straight into the binary, with zero Node.js runtime dependency in production.
landing_hero_check_types: Compile-time type safety, end to end
landing_features_subtitle_prefix: Best practices covering the full lifecycle from design and build to test and packaging, organized into
landing_feature_contracts_desc: HTTP APIs and data models are declared in TypeSpec. A build step compiles them into OpenAPI 3.0 and drives code generation on both ends, so docs and implementation never drift apart.
landing_feature_backend_desc: Go 1.27 with Chi routing, a Context-Driven Transactor pattern, and clean layering that scales from a monolith to a distributed system when it needs to.
landing_feature_frontend_desc: React 19, Vite, TanStack Router (fully typed file-based routing), TanStack Query caching, Tailwind CSS v4 and the shadcn/ui component pattern.
landing_feature_safety_desc: Backend changes immediately show up in the React Query hooks and TypeScript types Orval generates for the frontend, catching field mismatches at compile time.
landing_feature_data_desc: No opaque ORM. Explicit SQL plus versioned Goose migrations; sqlc validates SQL syntax and types at build time, and pgx's native pool keeps throughput high.
landing_feature_delivery_desc: The Vite production build is embedded straight into the Go binary via go:embed. Zero Node.js runtime dependency in production — one file runs anywhere.
landing_architecture_title: A contract-first design and build pipeline
landing_architecture_subtitle_prefix: No more hand-maintained API docs or duplicated integration code — the
landing_architecture_subtitle_suffix: drives full-stack automation end to end.
landing_architecture_step1_desc: Declarative RESTful endpoints and data models, defined once in packages/contracts/
landing_architecture_step2_desc: Automatically compiles to a standard OpenAPI 3.0 spec and publishes an offline, interactive Scalar reference
landing_architecture_step3_desc: Go backend gets a typed server and validation from ogen; the frontend gets typed React Query hooks from Orval
landing_architecture_step4_desc: sqlc parses raw SQL into typed Go models; Goose manages controlled, forward-only migrations
landing_architecture_pipeline_desc: The frontend build is embedded into internal/platform/webui/dist and packaged into the binary with Go embed
landing_architecture_pipeline_step1_desc: pnpm build:web produces a compressed Vite production build
landing_architecture_pipeline_step2_desc: go:embed bundles the webui assets directly into the compiled binary
landing_architecture_pipeline_step3_desc: A minimal scratch/alpine image with a one-command Docker Compose start
landing_tech_subtitle: No over-engineering — the focus is developer experience, long-term maintainability and delivery certainty.
landing_cta_title: Ready to build your next full-stack app?
landing_cta_subtitle: One command clones a complete dev environment: a local database container, contract watching, hot reload on both ends and a live API.
